values: Discharge-limitations table column headers and units (lbs/day and mg/l; 30-Day Avg and Daily Max)
Monitoring-requirements columns in the same Flow row (1/Day frequency; Estimate sample type)
Contrasting pollutant rows on the same page that pair numeric limits with monitoring requirements

grounding.excerpt: Flow                     Report MGD        Report MGD        ***               ***                1/Day        Estimate
Dissolved Copper         N/A               N/A               Report            Report             1/Week               Grab

rationale: The obligation asks whether the Flow row 'Report MGD' entries in the discharge-limitation columns establish an enforceable numeric discharge limit for compliance comparison. The packet shows Flow's limitation cells contain the non-numeric token 'Report MGD' (lbs/day 30-Day Avg and Daily Max) and '***' (mg/l 30-Day Avg and Daily Max), not numeric maximum or minimum values. On the same page, pollutant rows that carry enforceable numeric limits use explicit numbers (e.g., Total Aluminum 0.78/0.75; Total Copper 0.011), while rows limited to reporting use 'Report' without a numeric cap (e.g., Dissolved Copper Report/Report). Flow follows the report-only pattern, not the numeric-limit pattern. Monitoring frequency (1/Day) and sample type (Estimate) specify how flow is measured but do not supply a numeric compliance threshold. Therefore the hypothesis that 'Report MGD' establishes an enforceable numeric discharge limit is rejected; the row establishes a reporting obligation in MGD units with no applicable numeric limit in the limitation columns for compliance comparison.
